Yes, that PDF distinction is exactly what I wanted: preserve normal pages as readable copies and keep direct PDFs as their original files.

I don’t think the overall management flow is quite finished yet, though. I still need to delete bookmarks, edit their address and description—not only the title—and avoid creating a duplicate when I save an address that’s already in my library. Those are important to keeping the collection trustworthy and uncluttered.
